body: Airbus's first A350F freighter now flies in a livery designed by the public, wrapping the fuselage in a parcel motif that reflects the cargo the aircraft carries. The design came from graphic designer John Feehan of Dublin and brothers Quinnten and Ellisten Iversen of Calgary, winners of an open competition that drew more than 4,000 entries. Their two submissions were merged by Airbus's corporate design team into a single livery, unveiled with the winners at the Paris Air Show in June 2023, and the winners' names are painted on the fuselage of the first A350F.

The competition ran from September 12 to November 28, 2022, and Airbus handed the first A350F's livery to the public rather than assigning it in-house. Feehan entered at the encouragement of his aviation-loving son, while Quinnten, then 16, and Ellisten, then 12, developed their concept together in Calgary. Quinnten, a student pilot at the time of entry, has since earned a commercial pilot's licence, while Ellisten shifted his school focus toward engineering with aerospace in mind.

In 2026 the merged design became paint on an aircraft, flying on the first A350F as it works through its flight-test campaign toward certification. The A350F, launched in 2021 as the freighter member of the A350 family, offers a 111-tonne payload, capacity for 42 pallets and a range of up to 4,700 nautical miles.
en.summary: The first Airbus A350F now flies in a parcel-themed livery designed by three public competition winners, four years after the open design contest.
en.title: Airbus A350F's public-designed parcel livery takes to the skies on first test aircraft

body: 空中巴士首架A350F貨機如今披上由大眾設計的塗裝，機身以包裹為主題，呼應這架貨機所承載的貨物。設計來自都柏林平面設計師John Feehan與卡加利的Quinnten、Ellisten Iversen兄弟，他們是公開徵件競賽的優勝者，競賽共收到超過4000件投稿。兩組優勝設計由空中巴士企業設計團隊合併為單一塗裝，並於2023年6月巴黎航空展與優勝者一同揭曉，優勝者的名字也漆於首架A350F機身上。
競賽於2022年9月12日至11月28日舉行，空中巴士把首架A350F的塗裝交給大眾設計，而非由內部指定。Feehan在熱愛航空的兒子鼓勵下參賽，Quinnten當時16歲、Ellisten當時12歲，兩兄弟在卡加利共同發展設計概念。Quinnten參賽時是學生飛行員，之後已取得商用飛行員執照；Ellisten則把學習重心轉向工程，並以航太領域為目標。
2026年，合併後的設計成為首架A350F機身上的實際塗裝，隨這架飛機進行飛測、邁向認證。A350F於2021年推出，是A350家族的貨機成員，酬載111噸、可裝載42個貨盤、航程可達4700海里。
zh.summary: 空中巴士首架A350F如今披上包裹主題塗裝升空，設計來自公開徵件競賽的3位優勝者，距競賽舉辦已4年。
